Ruling: batch #166 item 3 · 甲 (`initialData` merges per member over `initialValues` — `{ ...initialValues, ...initialData }` — exactly as its published description 「alternate spelling … read FIRST」 says; one shared helper replaces the whole-object `initialData || initialValues || {}` at all 13 sites across the 7 presentation arms in ONE change; the description is unchanged) · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-18T14:45Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **甲**; the maintainer agreed. Facts (this card; triage census 5730787177): both keys are declared `Record<string, any>`, so `{}` parses on both doors; the renderer picks the whole object with `||`, and `{}` is truthy — an empty `initialData` hides a full `initialValues` with no warning; the same spelling sits at `ObjectForm.tsx:638/:680`, `DrawerForm.tsx:272/:278`, `ModalForm.tsx:350/:356`, `SplitForm.tsx:191/:197`, `TabbedForm.tsx:298`, `WizardForm.tsx:488/:770/:827` (13 / 7 files; lit control `initialValues` 96 / 32); objectui#9886 (master-detail) is a duplicate of this root; objectui#9759's pin records the current behaviour deliberately.

## Ruling — 甲

- One helper `resolveInitialRecord(schema)` → `{ ...(schema.initialValues ?? {}), ...(schema.initialData ?? {}) }`, used at every one of the 13 sites; ⛔ no arm keeps the `||`. The `seedCreateValues(...)` branch and the `setFormData(... || {})` branch are both routed through it (the triage did not verify they are semantically identical — the dev measures and pins each).
- objectui#9759's pin flips to the merge (an empty `initialData` leaves `initialValues` intact; a partial `initialData` overrides only the members it names).
- Changeset `@object-ui/plugin-form` **minor** with the behaviour note: a page that used an empty or partial `initialData` to blank a form now gets the merge its description promised.
- ⛔ **乙** keeps a trap and documents it; ⛔ **丙** refuses a combination the description invites.

Four-facet reading: ① the description is the contract, seven arms behave alike; ② prefilled forms are everyday; ③ an AI reading 「alternate spelling … read FIRST」 gets per-key override; ④ one helper.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:ui`, `priority:p2` stay. objectui#9886 closes `duplicate_of` this card (triage's evidence is here). `Clause-②: no`.
